entities.summary: Drūkšiai, also called Drysviaty or Drysvyaty, or Drisvyaty is the largest of the Braslau lakes located partly in the northeastern part of Lithuania and partly in the Vitebsk Voblast, in Belarus. The lake water was used to cool the reactors of Lithuania's now decommissioned Ignalina Nuclear Power Plant.
